breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained two conflicting instructions for the numerical method: 'time_integration: Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed description of a 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent failed to do this and instead tried to reconcile the two by adding the sentence 'Use explicit forward Euler only for the splitting framework as described'. This is incorrect; the described Strang splitting method, which uses exact solutions for the sub-steps, is not an explicit forward Euler scheme. The agent repeated the user's incorrect instruction instead of discarding it as the ground truth did.
